title: Enabling Scientific Collaboration with JupyterHub
problem: Large-scale scientific instruments produce massive data while instrument time at HPC facilities is constrained. Research teams need to analyze experimental data in real-time during experiments, but HPC systems lack integrated support for multi-user interactive collaborative analysis.
motivation: Real-time collaborative data analysis at HPC centers enables faster scientific discovery and more efficient use of scarce instrument and compute resources.
method: Jupyter Real-Time Collaboration features are enhanced and integrated into HPC systems with security and user auditing mechanisms. JupyterHub provides isolated collaborative notebook environments integrated with HPC resource managers, maintaining full user traceability for security compliance at large facilities like NERSC.
key_novelty: Integration of real-time collaborative Jupyter notebooks into HPC environments with security and auditing capabilities for scientific data analysis workflows.
contributions: Enhancements to Jupyter platform for HPC-scale collaborative analysis
Security and auditing mechanisms for user traceability in multi-user HPC environments
Integration of real-time collaboration with HPC resource scheduling
Demonstration of collaborative workflow at national scientific facilities
limitations: Scalability limits for large teams, latency impact on real-time collaboration, and generalization to other HPC systems not discussed.
primary_theme: Real-time collaborative analysis for HPC scientific workflows
